verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business telephony service, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack only shows narrow AI-flavored features: AI-powered note-taking on a higher tier, voicemail-to-text, and smart spam protection. These are adjacent features, not a built-in assistant that users can hand arbitrary tasks to. No documentation describes such an agentic assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
